method: Dates parsed from spreadsheet serials with 1899-12-30 epoch. Unicode NFKD capitalization/accents/punctuation normalization. Grouped by full normalized label, election date and province; not person identity.

hypotheses.H1: SUPPORTED with cross-date repeat candidate labels; no immutable person ID in eight headers.
hypotheses.H0: REFUTED: repeated name labels occur across election dates.

ABR: Candidate linkage ambiguity empirically measured on entire original elected-row source, no false-positive identity rate established.
limits: Every election has 350 source rows by construction; rows mean elected listings, not all actual legislators later seated.
Same full label across dates does not prove same person; changed province/acronym does not alone prove different person.
No same-election exact full-name collision found; homonym exact negative control still requires independent source.
Count of candidates by name depends on normalization choices.
Last-public timestamp and independent identity attribution unknown.
